text:
deploy-bot: Canary alert on /v1/generate — p95 latency jumped to 680ms (threshold 600ms). Auto-rollback path available. Initiating hosted rollback to model v3.3.9 unless operator overrides.

anya: seeing same in grafana, EU and USW2 canary shards. Important: this route is used by a few dedicated customers via routing aliases — do we have isolation?

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback scope: hosted-only by default. Dedicated and Private deployments are not affected unless an operator explicitly triggers a pinned rollback.

michael: pausing release-notes broadcast and feature flag anneal. I'm standing up a short monitoring window. @sam_ops can you prep CS comms in case this expands?

sam_ops: will prepare a short template. We only notify dedicated customers if control-plane rollout touches their pools. For now send brief to #customer-success and incident ops: "Heads-up: brief model rollback occurred to mitigate latency spike; monitoring."

julie_p: please pin the release: tag the current candidate commit as reverted (branch `release/2026-03-23`). I'll add a line in changelog: "Rollback: reverted model update for /v1/generate — latency regression."

eng_lead: decision: allow autorollback to complete for hosted. Human monitor for 5m. If we see error increase or errors > 1% then escalate to full manual rollback and customer comms. Who takes manual execution if needed?

michael: I'll take manual exec if autorollback doesn't stabilize. Manual runbook snippet below for reference:

```
# rollback hosted service to previous model version
deploy rollback --service inference-hosted --to-version v3.3.9
# ensure traffic fully points to v3.3.9
traffic split set --route /v1/generate --version v3.3.9 --weight 100
# monitor
rollout monitor --route /v1/generate --metric latency_p95 --threshold 350
```

nanya: :thumbsup: draft customer blurb: "We briefly reverted the model serving /v1/generate to a prior variant to mitigate increased latency. No action required from customers; we'll post a follow-up with root cause."

sam_ops: filing internal incident and adding to postmortem board. CS template ready, will send when eng_lead gives final go.

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback completed on hosted-usw2 at 1747654350. Traffic fully on v3.3.9. Telemetry: p95 dropped to 210ms. Continuing 10m watch.

michael: seeing metrics improve across canary shards. p95 stable ~220ms. No error increase.

eng_lead: keep monitoring 15m. If stable, we close out with an internal blameless postmortem. Assign RCA to @anya and @michael.

anya: will capture perf traces, kv-cache heatmaps, and compile model kernel selection logs.

julie_p: release note draft created: "Reverted model variant for /v1/generate due to canary latency regression; under investigation."

sam_ops: CS notified (internal note + brief). Updating comms doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/comm-templates/rollback-short-note (internal).

deploy-bot: Reminder: manual rollback commands (if needed): `deployctl rollback --cluster hosted-global --version v3.3.9` and `rollout monitor --route /v1/generate`. Full runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-hosted-models

michael: thanks all. I'll keep this thread updated if I need to trigger manual rollback or pin versions across regions.

eng_lead: post-action items: schedule follow-up postmortem, check kernel selection heuristics, and review deploybot thresholds.

anya: noted — will add perf regression test to the canary suite to catch this class earlier.

julie_p: will publish a short customer-facing note once RCA is ready.

(emoji reactions: :white_check_mark: from michael, :eyes: from eng_lead)
